verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payments SaaS that handles merchant and payment data, so an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions AI model training, opt-outs, or data-use restrictions. The data-ownership-and-export statement is an adjacent data-rights claim, not a training prevention control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
